def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); types = list(feats.types)
    S = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    Z = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == t for s in feats.stratum], float) for t in S[1:]])
    R = np.corrcoef(X.T); R = np.nan_to_num(R)
    def ll(M):
        b = np.zeros(M.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30)))
            W = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = M.T @ (M * W[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(M.shape[1])
            st = np.linalg.solve(H, M.T @ (y - mu)); b += st
            if np.max(np.abs(st)) < 1e-8: break
        mu = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu)))
    def col(t): return X[:, t[0]] * X[:, t[1]] if isinstance(t, tuple) else X[:, t]
    def fit(terms): return ll(np.column_stack([Z] + [col(t) for t in terms]))
    deg = (np.abs(R) >= 0.6).sum(0) - 1
    hubs = [j for j in np.argsort(-deg)[:3] if deg[j] >= 3 and types[j] == 'clinical']
    def ctx(sel, j): return [h for h in hubs if h != j and all(abs(R[h, s]) < 0.6 for s in sel)]
    def gain(sel, j):
        c = ctx(sel + [j], j); return 2 * (fit(sel + c + [j]) - fit(sel + c))
    sel = []; gates = [0.01, 0.01, 0.005]
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        cand = [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel and all(abs(R[j, s]) < 0.6 for s in sel)]
        if not cand: break
        g = [gain(sel, j) for j in cand]; k = int(np.argmax(g))
        if stats.chi2.sf(g[k], 1) > gates[min(len(sel), 2)] / p: break
        j = cand[k]
        clus = [m for m in range(p) if abs(R[j, m]) >= 0.6 and m not in sel and all(abs(R[m, s]) < 0.6 for s in sel)]
        if len(clus) > 1:
            gl = {m: gain(sel, m) for m in clus}
            ok = [m for m in clus if gl[m] >= g[k] - 4]
            cost = {m: sum(max(gain(sel + [m], o), 0) for o in clus if o != m) for m in ok}
            hk = [m for m in ok if m in hubs]
            j = hk[0] if hk else min(ok, key=lambda m: (cost[m], -gl[m]))
        sel.append(j)
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [s for s in sel if s != j]
            if stats.chi2.sf(gain(rest, j), 1) > 0.01 / p:
                sel.remove(j); changed = True; break
    base = sel + ctx(sel, -1); L0 = fit(base)
    mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-(np.log(y.mean() / (1 - y.mean())))))
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    P = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs]); P = (P - P.mean(0)) / (P.std(0) + 1e-9)
    sc = (P.T @ (y - mu)) ** 2 / (n * mu * (1 - mu))
    prods = []; npair = len(pairs)
    for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:20]:
        a, b = pairs[i]
        if any(abs(R[a, u]) >= 0.6 and abs(R[b, v]) >= 0.6 or abs(R[a, v]) >= 0.6 and abs(R[b, u]) >= 0.6 for u, v in prods): continue
        mains = [t for t in (a, b) if t not in base]
        Lm = fit(base + mains); Lp = fit(base + mains + [(a, b)])
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (Lp - Lm), 1) < 0.005 / npair:
            prods.append((a, b))
        if len(prods) >= 2: break
    drivers = []
    for t in sel + [u for pr in prods for u in pr]:
        if t not in drivers and all(abs(R[t, d]) < 0.95 for d in drivers): drivers.append(t)
    drivers = drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    cols = list(dict.fromkeys(sel + [u for pr in prods for u in pr] + (ctx(sel, -1) if drivers else [])))
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
